gate.anchor_rule: every anchor query must return at least one hit in stage 1 (AND of quoted abs: phrases). If any anchor misses, stage 2 re-runs ALL queries uniformly with OR of the same phrases (never only the empty ones). If any anchor still misses after stage 2, the whole search is VOID for claims.
gate.rate_limit_rule: HTTP 429 responses are retried with exponential backoff and recorded separately from genuinely empty results.
